pick.headline: Andrey Sakharov returns to Moscow from exile
pick.summary: On 23 December 1986 Andrey Sakharov and Yelena Bonner returned to Moscow by train after nearly seven years of internal exile in Gorkiy.
pick.significance: His return gave Gorbachev's glasnost credibility abroad and brought the leading Soviet dissident back into public life.

alternates.headline: Slovenians vote for independence
alternates.summary: On 23 December 1990 Slovenians voted overwhelmingly in a plebiscite for independence from Yugoslavia.
alternates.significance: The vote set the course for the breakup of Yugoslavia in 1991.
